metadata.title: Local crystallization in three-dimensional quantization
metadata.abstract: A long-standing conjecture on the quantization problem due to Gersho, which remains open in dimensions higher than two, posits that optimal quantizers crystallize into a lattice structure; in dimension three, the natural candidate is the body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice, known to be optimal among other lattices. In this paper, we establish the asymptotic local optimality of the BCC lattice under small periodic perturbations, extending its known stability beyond the class of lattice configurations. Our approach connects the discrete geometry of Voronoi tessellations with a continuum variational problem, showing that the rescaled quadratic quantization energies converge to a continuum functional describing locally deformed BCC lattices. A central ingredient is a geometric and algebraic framework that combines the stability of the BCC Voronoi structure, a discrete calculus on its adjacency graph and an analysis of the lattice symmetries via representation theory, allowing us to establish the positivity of the second variation at the BCC configuration and thereby prove the local minimality of the BCC lattice for the limiting energy.

analysis.progressType: 三维量化的局部晶格稳定性
analysis.workSummary: 证明 BCC 格在小周期扰动下的渐近局部最优性，以 Voronoi 离散几何和表示论建立二次变分正性，并将缩放二次量化能量联系到连续形变泛函。
techniques: BCC 对称表示与二次变分
analysis.breakthrough: 把 BCC 的最优性研究从格构型扩展到邻近的周期非格扰动。
analysis.limitations: 仅为局部、渐近及小扰动结论，三维 Gersho 全局结晶猜想仍未解决。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
